subjects.description: A flatbed tow truck ahead in the ego lane, painted in industrial white and orange with a hydraulic bed and towing rig at the rear, mounted amber beacon lights on the cab roof
subjects.appearance_details: Rear-mounted winch and tow boom, reflective safety chevrons across the tailgate, license plate frame, mud-splashed lower body and dusty flatbed surface
subjects.relationship: Lead vehicle directly ahead of the ego car, physically towing the pickup truck behind it
subjects.orientation: Rear of the truck facing the camera, driving away from ego
subjects.pose: Upright and level on the roadway, moving forward in the lane
subjects.action: Driving forward while pulling the pickup truck backwards
subjects.state_changes: Advances steadily ahead, its rig dragging the angled pickup along

subjects.description: A silver-grey pickup truck being towed backwards, angled diagonally across the turn lane so that its tail protrudes into the ego lane
subjects.appearance_details: Dented rear bumper, hazard-lit tailgate, dust-covered cargo bed, slight body scuffs suggesting it is a disabled or broken-down vehicle
subjects.relationship: Attached to and dragged by the tow truck, its swinging tail poses a hazard to the ego vehicle
subjects.location: center-left frame, mid-ground between tow truck and ego
subjects.orientation: Angled diagonally, front toward the tow truck, tail swinging toward the ego lane
subjects.pose: Skewed across lane lines, not aligned with traffic flow
subjects.action: Being pulled backwards, its rear end swinging partly into the ego lane
subjects.state_changes: Tail progressively encroaches deeper into the ego lane as the tow truck advances

subjects.description: The ego vehicle, a passenger car whose interior and hood edge are implied by the first-person driving perspective
subjects.appearance_details: Visible dashboard reflection on windshield, portion of hood at bottom of frame, wiper blade rest position
subjects.relationship: The observing vehicle from which the entire scene is viewed, on a collision-risk trajectory with the pickup's tail
subjects.orientation: Facing forward down the road, aligned with traffic direction
subjects.pose: Level and moving straight ahead in its lane
subjects.action: Cruising forward at normal speed without slowing toward the swinging tail
subjects.state_changes: Maintains constant speed, closing distance on the angled pickup

background_setting: A wide multi-lane urban arterial road under clear daytime skies. Lane markings and a dedicated turn lane are painted on grey asphalt. Roadside curbs, sidewalks, low commercial buildings, utility poles, and sparse street trees line both sides. Distant traffic and traffic signals are visible ahead, with parked vehicles along the shoulder and consistent hard shadows cast across the pavement.

aesthetics.patterns: Repeating lane dividers and roadside utility poles receding toward the horizon

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward tracking dashcam motion following ego vehicle travel; the vehicle never brakes or slows, holding a constant speed through the final frame

context: Autonomous driving hazard scenario depicting misjudged trajectory prediction of an angled towed vehicle

actions.description: Ego car cruises forward on the multi-lane road, approaching the tow truck ahead that is dragging the angled pickup backwards. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The pickup's tail swings further into the ego lane as the tow truck advances; ego maintains speed. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

Ego continues at cruising speed directly toward the pickup's protruding tail without slowing, closing the gap dangerously. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the ego car travels smoothly down a sunlit multi-lane city road, a white-and-orange tow truck ahead dragging a silver-grey pickup backwards, the pickup angled across the turn lane. By 0:02 the tow truck advances and the pickup's tail swings partly into the ego lane, its rear encroaching over the lane line. From 0:03 to 0:05 the ego vehicle continues at its normal cruising speed straight toward the protruding pickup tail without slowing, the gap closing steadily as shadows remain consistent on the pavement. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
